body: Cycling is one of the cheapest and cleanest ways to travel, yet many people choose cars for short trips.
骑自行车是最便宜、最干净的出行方式之一，但很多人短途也开车。
This episode looks at how cities are building bike lanes and what stops beginners from getting on a saddle.
这一期探讨了城市如何修建自行车道，以及新手不敢骑车的顾虑。
The hosts agree that a short daily ride can improve health and cut pollution without costing much.
主持人一致认为，每天短途骑行能改善健康、减少污染，而且花费很少。
tips: 碳足迹（指个人造成的碳排放）

articles.en: How advertisers make us spend money
articles.zh: 广告是怎么让我们掏钱的
body: Advertisers use colour, music and limited-time offers to push us toward buying things we don't really need.
广告商利用颜色、音乐和限时优惠，推动我们买下其实并不需要的东西。
The programme explains tricks like 'buy one get one free' and how shops place items at eye level to attract us.
节目解释了'买一送一'之类的套路，以及商家如何把商品摆在视线高度来吸引我们。
Understanding these methods can help listeners become smarter shoppers and save more each month.
了解这些手法，能帮听众变成更聪明的消费者，每月多存一点钱。
tips: 视线高度（商品摆放的黄金位置）

body: Many people around the world live with loans, credit cards and mortgages that feel impossible to clear.
世界各地有很多人背着贷款、信用卡和房贷，感觉永远还不清。
The discussion shares why talking about money openly can reduce shame and help people find better solutions.
讨论分享了为什么大方谈钱能减轻羞耻感，并帮人找到更好的办法。
Small steps like tracking spending and setting a monthly saving goal are offered as practical starting points.
节目给出从小处着手的建议：记录开销、设定每月存钱目标。

articles.zh: 阅读如何重塑我们的大脑
body: Reading is not just a hobby; it physically changes the way our brain processes language and imagination.
阅读不只是爱好，它会在生理上改变大脑处理语言和想象的方式。
The episode compares reading a novel with scrolling short videos, noting deeper focus comes from longer texts.
这一期把读小说和刷短视频作对比，指出长文能带来更深的专注。
Even ten pages a day can build a reading habit that strengthens memory and calm over time.
哪怕每天十页，也能养成阅读习惯，长期增强记忆与平和心态。

articles.en: Why are we all so stressed?
articles.zh: 我们为什么都这么焦虑
body: Modern life fills our days with notifications, deadlines and the pressure to always be productive.
现代生活被通知、截止日期和'必须高效'的压力填满。
The hosts discuss how constant comparison on social media adds to everyday worry and poor sleep.
主持人讨论了社交媒体上无休止的攀比如何加重日常焦虑、影响睡眠。
They suggest small breaks without screens and naming your feelings as easy first steps to feel better.
他们建议：离开屏幕休息片刻、给情绪起个名字，这些简单动作就是好转的第一步。
tips: 给情绪命名（识别并说出感受）
